player_prompt.intro:
Yu em Pleya {player_id} long Chopsticks. Long turn bilong yu, chusim wan bilong dispela:
  + Atak:  '[attack M O]'  we M=han bilong yu (0 o 1), O=han bilong opponent (0 o 1).
    - Han bilong opponent i go up long han bilong yu; if >=5, em i go bek long 0.
  + Split:   '[split L R]'  long redistribute olgeta finger bilong yu long L na R (L+R = olgeta bilong yu).
Reply wantaim wan bilong dispela komando.

invalid_move.my_hand_dead: Han bilong yu {my_idx} i dai pinis.
invalid_move.opp_hand_dead: Han bilong opponent {opp_idx} em i dai pinis.
invalid_move.split_sum: Namba bilong ol dispela hap em {total}.
invalid_move.split_no_change: Split i mas senisim pasin bilong yu long tilim han.
invalid_move.invalid_command: Muvim i no gut. Usim “[attack M O]” o “[split L R]”.

game_action.attack: P{player_id} i go long han bilong P{opp_id} {opp_idx}: em i lusim {opp_val} na i go kamap {new_val}.

outcome.win: Tupela han bilong narapela i dai pinis.
outcome.draw: Mipela i kamap pinis long mak bilong tanim.
